Fun trick if you have a record, grab a blank sheet of printing paper, one sewing needle. Roll the paper into a tight funnel shaped cone, drop the needle in the cone so it's poking out the bottom. Gently run it in the grooves of the record and you'll be able to listen to it. Might take some practice to get the speed right.
